contents.name: Theorem1.23(ii)->(iii): existence of a compact Zariski-dense subgroup for every complex reductive group; explicitly omitted in this full source
contents.reason: The commissioned complete-reducibility/Reynolds theorem asserts compact averaging conditionally on a supplied compact Zariski-dense K. Its unconditional complete-reducibility conclusion is proved by the local algebraic Lie bridge with exact published inputs. Compact subgroup existence is not a commissioned statement and is neither imported nor claimed proved; this source direction remains omitted in Brion and is not used by any local proof.
